segments.text:
V. 8.
He—Obſerve his twofold Office, toward the World, ver, 8, &c. toward Believers, ver. 12, &c. will convince—All of the world—Who do not obſtinately reſiſt, by your Preaching and Miracles, of ſin, and of righteouſneſs, and of judgment—He who is convinced of ſin, either accepts the righteouſneſs of Chriſt, or is judged with Satan. An abundant Accompliſhment of this, we find in the Acts of the Apoſtles.
